title: Titanium Cardiovascular Stent
alloyReason: Nitinol (ASTM F2063, 55-60 wt% Ni) is specified for Titanium Cardiovascular Stent where superelastic recovery up to 8% strain at body temperature enables self-expanding or self-centering functionality. The austenite finish temperature (A_f) is set 10-15°C below operating temperature to ensure complete martensite-to-austenite transformation. This shape memory behavior is uniquely suited for Self-expanding cardiovascular stent (Nitinol) requiring reversible deformation. This rationale is driven by self-expanding cardiovascular stent (nitinol) and specific design requirements.
process: CNC swiss turning for cardiovascular geometry
Ultrasonic clean Class 10k for net-shape tolerance
surfaceTreatment: Electropolishing + passivation per ASTM F86 (20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C) achieving Ra <0.2um for implant-grade finish — tailored for selfexpanding cardiovascular stent application
commonFailures: Galvanic pitting at Ti-316L interface in vivo - eliminated by ceramic Al2O3 coating on mating surfaces — critical for selfexpanding cardiovascular stent performance

faq.q: What biocompatibility standards does Titanium Cardiovascular Stent comply with?
faq.a: Titanium Cardiovascular Stent is manufactured from Nitinol which meets ISO 10993 biocompatibility requirements including cytotoxicity, sensitization, and irritation testing. The material's long clinical history in surgical and implantable devices provides documented biocompatibility data. All processing chemicals are selected to avoid leachables that could affect selfexpanding cardiovascular stent performance.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Cardiovascular Stent orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Cardiovascular Stent is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Cardiovascular Stent?
faq.a: Each Titanium Cardiovascular Stent shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for selfexpanding cardiovascular stent.
